extDescription.message: Ivimba izikhangiso zevidiyo ze-YouTube, amabhena, ama-pop-up, abalandeleli nezindonga ze-anti-adblock yonke indawo. Mahhala.

cosmeticsTitle.message: Ukuhlunga kokubukeka kule sayithi (kuvale uma isakhiwo sekhasi siphuka)

logUnavailable.message: Irekhodi alitholakali manje (umkhawulo wesiphequluli) — zama futhi ngemva komzuzu.

opt_block_tracking_beacons_and_cryptomin.message: Vimba amasiginali okulandelela nezinhlelo zokumba i-crypto

opt_keep_settings_allowlist_and_filters_.message: Gcina izilungiselelo, uhlu lwabavunyelwe nezihlungi kuvumelanisiwe kuyo yonke i-Chrome ongene ngayo ku-akhawunti

opt_remove_video_ads_on_youtube_turn_off.message: Isusa izikhangiso zevidiyo ku-YouTube. Kuvale uma amavidiyo engadlali.

opt_hide_disable_your_adblocker_walls_an.message: Fihla izindonga ezithi “vala i-adblocker yakho” futhi ubuyisele ikhasi

opt_strip_utm_fbclid_gclid_and_other_cli.message: Susa i-utm_*, i-fbclid, i-gclid nezinye izihlonzi zokuchofoza kumalinki owavulayo

opt_block_known_malware_domains_urlhaus_.message: Vimba izizinda ze-malware ezaziwayo (uhlu lwe-URLhaus lwe-abuse.ch)

opt_disable_google_topics_floc_and_prote.message: Khubaza ama-API ezikhangiso e-Google Topics, FLoC ne-Protected Audience kuyo yonke isayithi

opt_stop_third_party_hyperlink_auditing_.message: Imisa ama-ping okuhlola amalinki / ama-beacon ezinkampani zangaphandle, isuse amakhukhi okulandelela ezimpendulweni ezaziwayo zobuchwepheshe bezikhangiso, futhi ivimbe amaskripthi okumba i-crypto esiphequluli. Kuvale uma isici sesayithi esincike kuma-analytics singasebenzi kahle.

opt_fetches_new_block_rules_and_youtube_.message: Ilanda imithetho emisha yokuvimba nokulungiswa kwe-YouTube kusuka ku-adblock.carbonstealth.eu cishe kabili ngosuku. Idatha kuphela, ayikho ikhodi; isicelo asiphathi izihlonzi noma idatha yokuphequlula.

opt_live_log_of_ads_caught_heuristically.message: Irekhodi elibukhoma lezikhangiso ezibanjwe ngokuqagela (ngaphandle kohlu lwezihlungi), ezintsha kuqala.

opt_subscribed_lists_are_fetched_as_text.message: Izinhlu obhalisele kuzo zilandwa njengombhalo (hhayi neze njengekhodi), zibuyekezwa nsuku zonke, futhi zihlala emabhulokini aphethwe ngenhla. Susa uhlu ukuze ulahle imithetho yalo.

opt_elements_you_hid_manually_with_the_p.message: Ama-elementi owafihle ngesandla ngesikhethi, ahlelwe ngesayithi.

opt_live_diagnostics_everything_is_compu.message: Ukuhlola okubukhoma — konke kubalwa kule divayisi. Uma okuthile kubomvu, “Buyekeza manje” noma ukulayisha kabusha isandiso kuvame ukukulungisa.

opt_supreme_adblock_is_free_for_everyone.message: I-Supreme AdBlock imahhala kuwo wonke umuntu. Uma ungathanda ukusiza ukuthi iqhubeke inakekelwa, iminikelo yamukelekile, kodwa ayidingeki neze.

opt_smart_desc.message: Ibamba izikhangiso okungakabikho uhlu lwezihlungi oluzaziyo: amafreyimu avela kwezinye izizinda anosayizi wezikhala ezijwayelekile zezikhangiso afihlwa ngokushesha, akudingeki mithetho.

opt_filter_status.message: Isethi yezihlungi v$1, ibuyekezwe $2. Idatha kuphela, akukho lutho ngawe oluthunyelwayo.

opt_lists_intro.message: I-EasyList ne-EasyPrivacy zihlala zivuliwe. Izinhlu ezingezansi zinelayisensi evulekile futhi zakhelwe ngaphakathi kwesandiso, ngakho ukuvula olulodwa akulandi lutho, ngaphandle kohlu olumakwe njengoluvela kumbhali walo.

opt_lists_regional_desc.message: Uhlu lolimi lwesiphequluli sakho luzivulela lona. Engeza ezinye uma uvame ukufunda amasayithi ngezinye izilimi.

opt_focus_desc.message: Fihla okungesona isikhangiso kodwa okusaphazamisa. Konke lapha kuvaliwe uze ukuvule.

opt_list_ubo_desc.message: Izikhangiso, abalandeleli, ukulungiswa kwe-anti-adblock nokulungiswa kwamasayithi okuvela eqenjini le-uBlock Origin.

opt_list_plowe_desc.message: Uhlu oludala oluqhubekayo lwamaseva ezikhangiso nawokulandelela.

opt_focus_social_desc.message: Izinkinobho zokwabelana, amabhokisi okuthanda nokuphakelwayo okushumekiwe.

opt_focus_newsletters_desc.message: Amabhokisi nezimbozo ezithi “Bhalisela incwadi yethu yezindaba”.

opt_focus_notifications_desc.message: Amabhokisi athi “Vumela izaziso?” amasayithi awabonisa ngaphambi kokuthi isiphequluli sibuze.

opt_focus_ai_desc.message: Amabhamuza e-chatbot namaphaneli eziphakamiso ze-AI engezwe emakhasini.

opt_focus_other_desc.message: Imigoqo enamathelayo, amabhena athi “vula ku-app” nezinye iziphazamiso ezifanayo.

opt_remote_hint.message: Akufakiwe (ayikho ilayisensi yokuluphinda lusakazwe): isiphequluli sakho silulanda ku-$1 uma uluvula.

opt_lists_error.message: I-Chrome yenqabe lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezinhlu ($1). Vala ezinye.

rep_fix_desc.message: Izinkinga eziningi ziyanyamalala ngokukodwa kwalokhu. Ngakunye kusebenza kule sayithi kuphela; ithebhu iyalayisha kabusha.

rep_tell_desc.message: Silungisa amasayithi onakele kuwo wonke umuntu ngesibuyekezo sezihlungi esisayiniwe, ngokuvamile phakathi nosuku. Isandiso asithumeli lutho: umbiko uvuleka ku-app yakho ye-imeyili, futhi ubona wonke amagama awo kuqala.

rep_what_ph.message: isb. ividiyo ayiqali, ibhokisi elimhlophe limboza i-athikili…

rep_full_url.message: Faka ikheli eliphelele lekhasi (uma kungenjalo igama lesayithi kuphela)

rep_done_cosm.message: Ukufihla ama-elementi kuvaliwe kule sayithi. Kulayishwe kabusha — kulungile manje?

rep_done_allow.message: Izikhangiso zivunyelwe kule sayithi. Kulayishwe kabusha — kulungile manje?

rep_done_pause.message: Kumisiwe imizuzu engu-30. Uma isayithi isebenza manje, sicela usitshele ngezansi.

opt_focus_onetap_desc.message: Isikhethi se-akhawunti esivela ekhoneni lamasayithi amaningi. Izinkinobho zokungena ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza.
